title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-17
lineage: AUD > MC > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Listenably rough audience recording of a brief, disputed Fillmore show with heartfelt playing but questionable authenticity.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a short set from the early‑70 Fillmore era that many fans find emotionally sincere and rare, though the audio is typical of the low‑fidelity AUD sources of the period—muddy at times but still listenable. Reviewers are divided over the true date and venue, with some insisting it’s an August 17 1970 Fillmore West show while others argue it originates from a different night entirely. The overall impression is mixed: good enough for collectors who value rarity, yet hampered by uncertain provenance and modest sound quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews acknowledge decent musical moments but repeatedly note poor/rare audio quality and confusion over the recording’s true source, resulting in an average overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Typical early‑70 AUD tape: limited fidelity, some muddiness and ambient crowd noise, but generally listenable; reviewers mention the tape is rare and has a bit of ambiance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Brief, incomplete set with disputed track list; some listeners note heartfelt playing while others call it incoherent due to authenticity issues.
